name: Decay in Crevice
source:
Most parts of the home planet have been submerged. Its people started to live in different moons and planets, but stale crops and artificial livestock, everything will never be as good as their home planet. And when they have found a reachable planet, they think they can live in, what are they going to do?

Short space opera visual novel created by Team Celephaïs in 3 days for BGDJam 2022.

[From [url=https://usarin.itch.io/dc]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
母星的大部分地区已被淹没。它的人民开始生活在不同的卫星和行星上，但陈腐的农作物和人工牲畜，一切永远不会像他们的家乡星球那样好。当他们找到了一个可以到达的星球，他们认为他们可以居住时，他们会做什么？

Team Celephaïs在3天内为BGDJam 2022创作了短篇太空歌剧视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://usarin.itch.io/dc]Itch.io[/url]]
